title: fix(app-shell): Studio's Interfaces pillar hands its page inspectors the package's real read-only flag (objectui#11136)
body:
Fixes #11136
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

On a read-only package (a source-loaded package, `writable: false`), `InterfacesPillar` blocks both of its autosaves on `readOnly` and hides its nav "Edit" toggle, but the editors it opens for a nav leaf ignored the flag. The block inspector (`Inspector`) and the default inspector (`DefaultInspector`) were created with a hardcoded `readOnly={false}`. The canvas `Preview` and a source page's `SourcePageEditor` (the rail's editor for an `html` / `react` page) were handed the pillar's `onPatch` unconditionally. An edit therefore took on screen, nothing said it would not persist, and nothing was saved.

## What changed (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `InterfacesPillar` only)

- **Both inspectors** take the pillar's real `readOnly`, threaded the way the Data pillar (objectui#2259) and the Automations pillar (objectui#11124, PR objectui#11135) thread it. ⛔ No second read-only mechanism. No inspector file moved: `PageBlockInspector` and `PageDefaultInspector` (a `SchemaForm`) already disable their inputs on `readOnly`, which is what the pins below measure.
- **The `readOnly` docblock** widens from "nav-authoring affordances" to all interface-authoring affordances, with nav editing, the canvas's in-place edits and every editor in the right rail included. This matches the Data / Automations wording, per triage `5898691979`. It is a comment on an internal prop, not a contract change.
- **Declared bounded in-place fix: the canvas and the source editor.** Both were the card's own symptom on two more affordances of the same pillar: an edit that takes locally while the blocked autosave discards it. I fixed them in place because the four conditions hold:
  1. It is the same defect class as this card.
  2. It is mechanical, and its shape is each component's own documented read-only contract, not a second mechanism. For the canvas, `onPatch` is omitted on a read-only package, which `MetadataPreviewProps.onPatch` documents as "When omitted, the preview surface is read-only". PR objectui#11135 landed the same shape for the Automations canvas. For the source editor, `readOnly` plus `onPatch` omitted, which `SourcePageEditor` documents as "Patch the draft; undefined in read-only mode"; `PagePreview` already feeds it that way.
  3. It is the same file as this claim, and no other claim holds it.
  4. It is the same gate family, with no new verification surface.

  Selecting a block or widget still opens the inspector, read-only. `StudioNavItemInspector` (objectui#11148's site) is not touched.

## Pins (`StudioDesignSurface.interfacesReadOnly-11136.test.tsx`)

The canvas and the inspectors are the real registered `PagePreview`, `PageBlockInspector` and `PageDefaultInspector`. The client is a server double that records every save. Every read-only case has a writable control, and each control proves that the edit reaches a save.

- read-only: every control of the default inspector (the page form) is disabled or read-only;
- read-only: a block still selects, and every control of the block inspector is disabled;
- read-only: the canvas offers no "Add block", and the block is not draggable;
- read-only: the source page's code editor is read-only, in the classic layout and in the folded layout (the two `SourcePageEditor` sites);
- writable, the controls: the page form edits and autosaves `label`; the canvas offers "Add block", the block is draggable, and the block inspector edits and autosaves the block `id`; the source editor edits and autosaves `source`; the folded source editor is editable.

## Reverse verification

The fix was committed first (`44e237a17`, pins completed in `49b14e79b`). Each leg went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which asserted that the anchor fell from 1 to 0, that the replacement rose from 0 to 1, and that the blob changed. It then ran the pin file, restored, and proved that the blob equals HEAD and that `git diff HEAD` is empty. The subject resolves through relative source imports, not a package `dist/`, so no rebuild step applies. Directions were registered before the run, and every leg answered as registered.

| leg | mutation | red | green |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | block inspector `readOnly={false}` again | block-inspector pin | other 8 |
| B | default inspector `readOnly={false}` again | default-inspector pin | other 8 |
| C | canvas handed `onPatch` again | canvas pin | other 8 |
| D | classic-layout source editor ungated | classic source-editor pin | other 8 |
| E | folded-layout source editor ungated | folded source-editor pin | other 8 |

Each leg read `Tests 1 failed / 8 passed (9)`.

## Gates (at `49b14e79b`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`, plus the tests that read `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` from disk (`homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373`, `spec-symbol-parity`, `spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265`) and `studio-locale.i18n`: 73 files, 461 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. It ran after the closure `@object-ui/app-shell^...` was built with turbo (28 of 28 tasks). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new test inside the test program.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the two changed `.tsx` files: 0 errors. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` has 18 warnings, the same per-rule counts as the base file, and none is on a changed line. The test file has 0 warnings.
- These gates all exited 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:handler-key-reads` and `check:unreferenced-sources`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the three paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- Left to CI: the full `pnpm test`, and the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm type-check`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise re-measured** at objectui `origin/main` `9babfa433`. Both `readOnly={false}` sites, the two autosaves blocked on `readOnly`, and the narrow docblock were all present as the card describes. Line numbers had moved since the card was written, so this body cites them by symbol.
- **Not separately pinned:** dashboard, report and action leaves. They go through the same two inspector props and the same canvas prop, and their registered inspectors read `readOnly` at source. The pins exercise page leaves only.
- **Scope beyond the claim's "two props and one docblock":** the canvas prop and the two source-editor sites are the declared in-place fix above, in the same file. The claim's file surface does not move.
- **`check:changeset-claims`** reports that `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md` names `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. That paragraph is about the file's static import of `SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx`, which this change does not touch, so it is still true.
- **Out of scope, reported to the seat and left alone here:** the pillar's `?sel=nav:ID` deep link (objectui#2272) did not open nav editing in an uncommitted probe. The probe mounted the real pillar at that URL on a writable package; no Done toggle appeared, and the rail showed the page form. It is read at source as the selection mirror effect deleting `sel` on mount, before the nav tree loads. The apply effect also calls `setEditNav(true)` without reading `readOnly`, so any repair has to gate it.
